changes: The existing browser bootstrap installs a bounded metadata-only reader. The SDK, observer callbacks and writable state remain private.
onSessionId observes natural IDs without allocating or injecting them; a natural session change or invalid ID clears stale snapshot evidence.
After the unchanged sanitizer runs, observe only $snapshot and its $session_id, then return the identical sanitized result. Never inspect the snapshot body or alter drop/masking behavior.
The reader rechecks real sessionRecordingStarted each time; no SDK/global window.posthog assumption, forced recording, opt-in, capture, reset or storage mutation.

The actor waits once under its existing deadline/abort using requestAnimationFrame polling, disposes the JS handle, then immediately rechecks the same current session/live state before its existing sole click.
Missing config/bridge, unknown or false SDK state, no same-session snapshot, malformed metadata, SDK errors, cancellation and timeout fail before submitClicks=1 and use existing page-first cleanup.
Only opaque session ID, closed booleans and timestamps enter the receipt. uploadAcknowledged remains null. Product code adds no timer or server polling.
